title: K.B Explainer Film
eyebrow: K.B · explainer · 58 s · 1920×1080 · storyboard and QC
headline: Diagnose, build, run
subtitle: The JustCall × HubSpot explainer Karl supplied, remade beat for beat for K.B: the same structure, pacing and kinds of motion, with K.B's own interface, words and voice. Only "K.B" is said and shown; people are initials, never photos.

direction.Purpose: A product-explainer for K.B's website and LinkedIn: what K.B does, how it works, and the call to talk.
direction.Audience: Founders and managers of startups and SMEs whose work still runs on manual steps.
direction.Core message: K.B builds the software and automation your business runs on, with you: diagnose, build, run, one loop.
direction.Reference: The JustCall × HubSpot explainer: logo circles open into an app window, a module switches on, a phone slides in, "How?", one window whose body changes while cards lift out of it, a dropdown pick, a workflow, tools joined up, avatars, a month calendar, an infinity loop, a logo-and-button end card, a brand mark in the corner. Nothing of its artwork, screens or words is used.
direction.Style and brand: K.B's site: canvas #F7F7F7 with soft blobs, white rounded windows with a navy app bar, cyan as the action colour (never text on light), Montserrat; Copperplate only in the K.B logotype.
direction.Motion: Precise and calm: arrivals on a gentle curve, MOVE for things already on screen, no overshoot. Windows stay whole in the frame and only creep (≤ 3% a second); cards lift out of them for emphasis, as in the reference. The camera only breathes.
direction.Words on screen: Only "How?" and "Need more?" as big words (as in the reference); everything else is interface text inside the pictures.
direction.Sound: ElevenLabs voice (Christina) at 1.60 s; Mixkit "Tears of Joy" cut on its bar grid, the band coming in as the audit window rises after "How?", the song's last hit on "K.B" and the end card; 139 effects on their moves (clicks, typing, landings, chimes).

beats.title: K.B builds the software and automation your business runs on, with you.

frames.what: Two white circles, K.B and "Your business", drift in and dock into one lockup.
The lockup opens into the business's workspace window; eight module cards land.
Automations fills with cyan, lifts out of the window and shows a big check.
Every module switches on; the window steps left and a phone slides in running the same workspace.
A large K.B tile drops in from above and "You" rises from below; they meet over the workspace.
Everything leaves left; "How?" rises among small drifting shapes.

beats.title: We start with a process audit: how your team works today, where the friction is, and what to improve first.

frames.phrase: we start with a process audit
frames.what: The audit window rises; a magnifier passes over the empty steps.
Five steps draw left to right, each with its team: Lead, Intake, Quote, Invoice, Follow-up.
Intake and Follow-up lift out of the window with a red "Manual" flag.
The K.B cursor opens Priority on Intake and picks "First"; a "1" badge lands.

beats.title: Then we build together, in the open.

frames.what: The window's body turns into a build board; the K.B and You cursors drag cards into Building.
The activity strip lifts: what was moved, by whom, "Shared with your team", seen by the team.

beats.title: Intake forms, follow-ups and CRM updates run on their own, with Make, n8n and AI agents doing the manual work.

frames.what: A client intake form lifts out, fills itself and is sent.
The form shrinks into the first node of a workflow; the CRM node updates.
The follow-up email arrives on the client's phone; the workflow shows "Running".
The Make and n8n tiles land on their nodes, each named for a moment.

frames.phrase: and AI agents doing the manual work
frames.what: An AI agent node (Claude) joins; more runs pass through by themselves.

beats.title: Need more? We build custom software: dashboards, websites and mobile apps, tailored to how your team already works.

frames.what: The workflow tucks away; "Need more?" rises.
A new window builds itself block by block.
It becomes a dashboard (labelled as example data): numbers count up, bars grow, a line draws.
A website slides in behind it.
An app slides in front; its sections are dragged into the team's own order.
The order is saved: a check on Today's jobs.

beats.title: Every tool you use, connected, so data flows without copy-paste.

frames.what: The screens slide away; the real tools from K.B's site land in a slowly turning ring round "Your system".
Lines draw from every tool to the centre.
Dots run along the lines; rings pulse out of the system.
Two keys, Copy and Paste, struck out in red.

beats.title: We work inside your team, not around it, so you always know what we're doing.

frames.what: A team channel: the team makes room and K.B takes a seat in the row; 5 members.

frames.phrase: you always know what we're doing
frames.what: K.B's status messages arrive in the channel.

beats.title: And after launch, we stay on: hosting, maintenance and new features every month as your business grows.

frames.what: "Go live" is clicked: Live.
A monthly plan opens; "K.B · on call" is pinned to the month.
Hosting and Maintenance lines run through every week.
A New feature lands in its day; the month turns.
Month 3: three features shipped.

beats.title: Diagnose, build, run: one loop, so your systems keep up with your growth.

frames.what: An infinity road draws from Diagnose.
Build and Run light in turn; the dots start running as the road closes.
All three stations light; the dots run round the loop.

frames.phrase: so your systems keep up with your growth
frames.what: The loop lifts; the stations pulse on "growth".

frames.words: Talk to K.B. · Book a Free Discovery Call
frames.what: The loop fades; the K.B logo, "Talk to K.B." built word by word, and the site's button in cyan.

notes: The voice-over is the script Karl recorded (script.md); nothing was rewritten. "K.B" is spoken and shown; "Consultancy" never appears.

Remade after the reference's structure, pacing and kinds of motion; none of its screens, logos, illustrations or wording is used. Every interface is an example built from K.B's own services and words.
People are initials only (AM, JS, RK, LT, You); K.B is its logo tile. Jordan Smith and Acme Studio are placeholder names in the example form; the dashboard numbers are labelled "Example data".
Tool logos (Pipedrive, Odoo, Supabase, Resend, Make, n8n, Claude, Next.js) are the ones K.B's site shows as tools it builds with.
No URL on the end card (the domain contains "consultancy"); the button is the site's own "Book a Free Discovery Call".
Nothing from the site's hero video (or any of its videos) was downloaded, sampled or used.
questions: Motion: the median frame moves 2.4% of its area — just under the reference (2.7%) and below the 5% you asked for on the last film. The review round made the moves calmer (no push-ins, cards lift instead, as in the reference). Want it livelier?
Music: Mixkit "Tears of Joy" (no credit needed), cut so its last hit lands on the end card. Keep it, or do you have a track?
End card: keep it URL-free, or add a domain without "consultancy" if K.B has one?
